Verses.VerseEn: Ha, Mim. (Only Allah and the Messenger [blessings and peace be upon him] know the real meaning.)

Verses.VerseAr: تَنۡزِيۡلُ الۡكِتٰبِ مِنَ اللّٰهِ الۡعَزِيۡزِ الۡعَلِيۡمِۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: The Revelation of this Book is from Allah, Almighty, All-Knowing,

Verses.VerseAr: غَافِرِ الذَّنۡۢبِ وَقَابِلِ التَّوۡبِ شَدِيۡدِ الۡعِقَابِ ذِىۡ الطَّوۡلِؕ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَؕ اِلَيۡهِ الۡمَصِيۡرُ‏
Verses.VerseEn: The Forgiver of sin, the Acceptor of repentance, the Severe in tormenting, the Lord of Bounty; there is no God but He; towards Him have (all) to return.

Verses.VerseAr: مَا يُجَادِلُ فِىۡۤ اٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ اِلَّا الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا فَلَا يَغۡرُرۡكَ تَقَلُّبُهُمۡ فِىۡ الۡبِلَادِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: No one disputes about the Revelations of Allah except those who do not believe. So let not their moving about (freely) in the cities delude you.

Verses.VerseAr: كَذَّبَتۡ قَبۡلَهُمۡ قَوۡمُ نُوۡحٍ وَّالۡاَحۡزَابُ مِنۡۢ بَعۡدِهِمۡ وَهَمَّتۡ كُلُّ اُمَّةٍۢ بِرَسُوۡلِهِمۡ لِيَاۡخُذُوۡهُؕ وَجَادَلُوۡا بِالۡبَاطِلِ لِيُدۡحِضُوۡا بِهِ الۡحَقَّ فَاَخَذۡتُهُمۡ  فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ عِقَابِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Before them the people of Nuh (Noah) and after them many (other) communities rejected (their Messengers). And every people intended to seize its Messenger (to assassinate or imprison him) and raised dispute through baseless issues to dilute (the influence of) the Truth by means of that (dispute). So I seized them (in torment). So how was (My) torment!

Verses.VerseAr: وَكَذٰلِكَ حَقَّتۡ كَلِمَتُ رَبِّكَ عَلَى الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡۤا اَنَّهُمۡ اَصۡحٰبُ النَّارِؔ‌ۘ‏
Verses.VerseEn: That is how the judgment of your Lord was fulfilled against those who disbelieved. Surely they are the inmates of Hell.

Verses.VerseAr: اَلَّذِيۡنَ يَحۡمِلُوۡنَ الۡعَرۡشَ وَمَنۡ حَوۡلَهٗ يُسَبِّحُوۡنَ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّهِمۡ وَيُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ بِهٖ وَيَسۡتَغۡفِرُوۡنَ لِلَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا‌ ۚ رَبَّنَا وَسِعۡتَ كُلَّ شَىۡءٍ رَّحۡمَةً وَّعِلۡمًا فَاغۡفِرۡ لِلَّذِيۡنَ تَابُوۡا وَاتَّبَعُوۡا سَبِيۡلَكَ وَقِهِمۡ عَذَابَ الۡجَحِيۡمِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: The angels who are bearing the Throne and those who are around it, (all) glorify their Lord with His praise and believe in Him and pray for forgiveness of the believers (and submit): ‘O our Lord, You encompass everything in (Your) Mercy and Knowledge. So forgive those who turn to You in repentance and follow Your path and protect them from the torment of Hell.

Verses.VerseAr: رَبَّنَا وَاَدۡخِلۡهُمۡ جَنّٰتِ عَدۡنِ اۨلَّتِىۡ وَعَدتَّهُمۡ وَمَنۡ صَلَحَ مِنۡ اٰبَآٮِٕهِمۡ وَاَزۡوَاجِهِمۡ وَذُرِّيّٰتِهِمۡؕ اِنَّكَ اَنۡتَ الۡعَزِيۡزُ الۡحَكِيۡمُۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: O our Lord! And admit them to the Gardens of Eden (for eternal living) You have promised them. And (with them admit also) the pious ones of their fathers and their wives and their children. Surely You are Almighty, Most Wise.

Verses.VerseAr: وَقِهِمُ السَّيِّاٰتِؕ وَمَنۡ تَقِ السَّيِّاٰتِ يَوۡمَٮِٕذٍ فَقَدۡ رَحِمۡتَهٗؕ وَذٰلِكَ هُوَ الۡفَوۡزُ الۡعَظِيۡمُ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And save them from (the punishment of) sins. And the one You saved from (the punishment of) sins that Day, You have indeed shown him great Mercy. And that is great success indeed.’

Words.MeaningEn: You have bestowed mercy on him

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا يُنَادَوۡنَ لَمَقۡتُ اللّٰهِ اَكۡبَرُ مِنۡ مَّقۡتِكُمۡ اَنۡفُسَكُمۡ اِذۡ تُدۡعَوۡنَ اِلَى الۡاِيۡمَانِ فَتَكۡفُرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Surely the disbelievers will be called out and addressed: ‘(Today) Allah’s displeasure with you is greater than your own disgust for yourselves while you used to deny when called to believe.’

Words.MeaningEn: will be cried out to them

Verses.VerseAr: قَالُوۡا رَبَّنَاۤ اَمَتَّنَا اثۡنَتَيۡنِ وَاَحۡيَيۡتَنَا اثۡنَتَيۡنِ فَاعۡتَرَفۡنَا بِذُنُوۡبِنَا فَهَلۡ اِلٰى خُرُوۡجٍ مِّنۡ سَبِيۡلٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: They will say: ‘O our Lord, You have caused us to die twice and You have (also) given us life twice. (Now) we confess our sins. So is there any way out (to escape from this chastisement)?’

Verses.VerseAr: ذٰلِكُمۡ بِاَنَّهٗۤ اِذَا دُعِىَ اللّٰهُ وَحۡدَهٗ كَفَرۡتُمۡۚ وَاِنۡ يُّشۡرَكۡ بِهٖ تُؤۡمِنُوۡاؕ فَالۡحُكۡمُ لِلّٰهِ الۡعَلِىِّ الۡكَبِيۡرِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (It will be said to them: ‘No,) this (eternal punishment) is due to the reason that when solely Allah was called upon you used to deny, but when (something) was associated with Him, you used to believe. So (now) the Command is Allah’s alone, Who is Most High, Supreme.’

Verses.VerseAr: هُوَ الَّذِىۡ يُرِيۡكُمۡ اٰيٰتِهٖ وَيُنَزِّلُ لَـكُمۡ مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ رِزۡقًاؕ وَمَا يَتَذَكَّرُ اِلَّا مَنۡ يُّنِيۡبُ‏
Verses.VerseEn: He is the One Who shows you His Signs and sends down sustenance for you from the heaven. And only he who remains inclined (to Allah alone) accepts advice.

Verses.VerseAr: فَادۡعُوۡا اللّٰهَ مُخۡلِصِيۡنَ لَهُ الدِّيۡنَ وَلَوۡ كَرِهَ الۡكٰفِرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So worship Allah for His own sake in sincere obedience and true devotion, even though the disbelievers may despise it.

Verses.VerseAr: رَفِيۡعُ الدَّرَجٰتِ ذُوۡ الۡعَرۡشِ‌ۚ يُلۡقِىۡ الرُّوۡحَ مِنۡ اَمۡرِهٖ عَلٰى مَنۡ يَّشَآءُ مِنۡ عِبَادِهٖ لِيُنۡذِرَ يَوۡمَ التَّلَاقِۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: The Exalter of Ranks and the Owner of the Mighty Throne, He sends His Spirit (i.e. Revelation) upon whoever of His servants He wills by His Command, so that He may warn them (people) of the Day of Assembly,

Verses.VerseAr: يَوۡمَ هُمۡ بَارِزُوۡنَ ‌ۚ  لَا يَخۡفٰى عَلَى اللّٰهِ مِنۡهُمۡ شَىۡءٌؕ لِمَنِ الۡمُلۡكُ الۡيَوۡمَؕ لِلّٰهِ الۡوَاحِدِ الۡقَهَّارِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: The Day when they all will come forth (from the graves), and nothing of their (deeds) will remain hidden from Allah. (Allah will say:) ‘Whose is the Kingdom this Day?’ (It will be further added:) ‘It belongs to Allah, the One, the Most Dominant.’

Verses.VerseAr: اَلۡيَوۡمَ تُجۡزٰى كُلُّ نَفۡسٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَتۡؕ لَا ظُلۡمَ الۡيَوۡمَؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ سَرِيۡعُ الۡحِسَابِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Today every soul will be rewarded for what it has earned. There will be no injustice Today. Surely Allah is Swift in taking an account.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاَنۡذِرۡهُمۡ يَوۡمَ الۡاٰزِفَةِ اِذِ الۡقُلُوۡبُ لَدَى الۡحَـنَاجِرِ كٰظِمِيۡنَ ؕ مَا لِلظّٰلِمِيۡنَ مِنۡ حَمِيۡمٍ وَّلَا شَفِيۡعٍ يُّطَاعُ ؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And warn them of the Day of impending calamity when hearts will rise to throats due to the suppressed grief. The wrongdoers will have neither any kind friend nor any influential intercessor.

Verses.VerseAr: يَعۡلَمُ خَآٮِٕنَةَ الۡاَعۡيُنِ وَمَا تُخۡفِىۡ الصُّدُوۡرُ‏
Verses.VerseEn: He knows the treacherous eyes and also those secrets which the breasts hide (inside them).

Verses.VerseAr: وَاللّٰهُ يَقۡضِىۡ بِالۡحَقِّؕ وَالَّذِيۡنَ يَدۡعُوۡنَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِهٖ لَا يَقۡضُوۡنَ بِشَىۡءٍؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ هُوَ السَّمِيۡعُ الۡبَصِيۡرُ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And Allah judges with truth, and the (idols) they worship other than Allah can judge nothing at all. Surely Allah is the One Who is All-Hearing, All-Seeing.

Verses.VerseAr: اَوَلَمۡ يَسِيۡرُوۡا فِىۡ الۡاَرۡضِ فَيَنۡظُرُوۡا كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الَّذِيۡنَ كَانُوۡا مِنۡ قَبۡلِهِمۡؕ كَانُوۡا هُمۡ اَشَدَّ مِنۡهُمۡ قُوَّةً وَّاٰثَارًا فِىۡ الۡاَرۡضِ فَاَخَذَهُمُ اللّٰهُ بِذُنُوۡبِهِمۡؕ وَمَا كَانَ لَهُمۡ مِّنَ اللّٰهِ مِنۡ وَّاقٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And have they not travelled in the land so that they could see what was the end of those who were before them? They were far mightier in power than these and (also) greater in their remains and signs (which they left behind) in the earth. Then Allah seized them for their sins and there was none to protect them from (the torment of) Allah.

Verses.VerseAr: ذٰلِكَ بِاَنَّهُمۡ كَانَتۡ تَّاۡتِيۡهِمۡ رُسُلُهُمۡ بِالۡبَيِّنٰتِ فَكَفَرُوۡا فَاَخَذَهُمُ اللّٰهُؕ اِنَّهٗ قَوِىٌّ شَدِيۡدُ الۡعِقَابِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: That was because their Messengers brought them open Signs but they denied. So Allah seized them (in the torment). Surely He is All-Powerful, Most Severe in punishing.

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَقَدۡ اَرۡسَلۡنَا مُوۡسٰى بِاٰيٰتِنَا وَسُلۡطٰنٍ مُّبِيۡنٍۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And indeed We sent Musa (Moses) with Our Signs and clear authority,

Verses.VerseAr: اِلٰى فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَهَامٰنَ وَقَارُوۡنَ فَقَالُوۡا سٰحِرٌ كَذَّابٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Towards Pharaoh, Haman and Qarun but they said: ‘He is a sorcerer, a great liar.’

Verses.VerseAr: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمۡ بِالۡحَقِّ مِنۡ عِنۡدِنَا قَالُوۡا اقۡتُلُوۡۤا اَبۡنَآءَ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا مَعَهٗ وَاسۡتَحۡيُوۡا نِسَآءَهُمۡؕ وَمَا كَيۡدُ الۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ اِلَّا فِىۡ ضَلٰلٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then when he came to them with the message of Truth from Us, they said: ‘Kill the sons of those who have believed with him but leave their women alive. And the treacherous plots of the disbelievers were nothing but ruination.

Verses.VerseAr: وَقَالَ فِرۡعَوۡنُ ذَرُوۡنِىۡۤ اَقۡتُلۡ مُوۡسٰى وَلۡيَدۡعُ رَبَّهٗ‌ۚ اِنِّىۡۤ اَخَافُ اَنۡ يُّبَدِّلَ دِيۡنَكُمۡ اَوۡ اَنۡ يُّظۡهِرَ فِىۡ الۡاَرۡضِ الۡفَسَادَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And Pharaoh said: ‘Leave me to kill Musa (Moses) and let him call his Lord. I fear he will change your religion or will spread violence in the country (Egypt).

Verses.VerseAr: وَقَالَ مُوۡسٰٓى اِنِّىۡ عُذۡتُ بِرَبِّىۡ وَرَبِّكُمۡ مِّنۡ كُلِّ مُتَكَبِّرٍ لَّا يُؤۡمِنُ بِيَوۡمِ الۡحِسَابِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And Musa (Moses) said: ‘I have taken refuge with my Lord and your Lord from every arrogant character who does not believe in the Day of Reckoning.’

Verses.VerseAr: وَقَالَ رَجُلٌ مُّؤۡمِنٌ ‌ۖ مِّنۡ اٰلِ فِرۡعَوۡنَ يَكۡتُمُ اِيۡمَانَهٗۤ اَتَقۡتُلُوۡنَ رَجُلاً اَنۡ يَّقُوۡلَ رَبِّىَ اللّٰهُ وَقَدۡ جَآءَكُمۡ بِالۡبَيِّنٰتِ مِنۡ رَّبِّكُمۡؕ وَاِنۡ يَّكُ كَاذِبًا فَعَلَيۡهِ كَذِبُهٗؕ وَاِنۡ يَّكُ صَادِقًا يُّصِبۡكُمۡ بَعۡضُ الَّذِىۡ يَعِدُكُمۡۚ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا يَهۡدِىۡ مَنۡ هُوَ مُسۡرِفٌ كَذَّابٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And a believing man from among the people of Pharaoh who had kept his faith secret said, ‘Do you kill a man (just) because he says: Allah is my Lord? And he has brought you clear Signs from your Lord. And if (suppose) he is a liar then the burden of his lie will fall back on him alone, but if he is truthful then as much torment is bound to seize you as he has promised you. Surely Allah does not give guidance to someone who exceeds limits and is a downright liar.

Verses.VerseAr: يٰقَوۡمِ لَكُمُ الۡمُلۡكُ الۡيَوۡمَ ظٰهِرِيۡنَ فِىۡ الۡاَرۡضِ  فَمَنۡ يَّنۡصُرُنَا مِنۡۢ بَاۡسِ اللّٰهِ اِنۡ جَآءَنَاؕ قَالَ فِرۡعَوۡنُ مَاۤ اُرِيۡكُمۡ اِلَّا مَاۤ اَرٰى وَمَاۤ اَهۡدِيۡكُمۡ اِلَّا سَبِيۡلَ الرَّشَادِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: O my people! You are in power today; (it is you who) are ruling over the land (of Egypt). But who can save us from the torment of Allah if that (torment) comes upon us?’ Pharaoh said: ‘I instruct you only what I myself deem (correct), and I do not show you (any path) except the path of righteousness.’

Verses.VerseAr: وَقَالَ الَّذِىۡۤ اٰمَنَ يٰقَوۡمِ اِنِّىۡۤ اَخَافُ عَلَيۡكُمۡ مِّثۡلَ يَوۡمِ الۡاَحۡزَابِۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And he who had embraced faith said: ‘O my people, I fear (the torment of) an evil day coming upon you (too) like the day that seized (the former) generations,

Verses.VerseAr: مِثۡلَ دَاۡبِ قَوۡمِ نُوۡحٍ وَّعَادٍ وَّثَمُوۡدَ وَالَّذِيۡنَ مِنۡۢ بَعۡدِهِمۡؕ وَمَا اللّٰهُ يُرِيۡدُ ظُلۡمًا لِّلۡعِبَادِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: On the pattern of the punishment of the People of Nuh (Noah), ‘Ad and Thamud and the later communities. And Allah does not intend any injustice to (His) servants.

Verses.VerseAr: وَيٰقَوۡمِ اِنِّىۡۤ اَخَافُ عَلَيۡكُمۡ يَوۡمَ التَّنَادِۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And, O people, I fear for you a Day of hue and cry (i.e. the Day of Rising),

Verses.VerseAr: يَوۡمَ تُوَلُّوۡنَ مُدۡبِرِيۡنَ‌ۚ مَا لَكُمۡ مِّنَ اللّٰهِ مِنۡ عَاصِمٍۚ وَمَنۡ يُّضۡلِلِ اللّٰهُ فَمَا لَهٗ مِنۡ هَادٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: The Day when you will turn your backs and flee away and there will be no one to save you from (the torment of) Allah and for him whom Allah holds astray there is no guide or leader.

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَقَدۡ جَآءَكُمۡ يُوۡسُفُ مِنۡ قَبۡلُ بِالۡبَيِّنٰتِ فَمَا زِلۡتُمۡ فِىۡ شَكٍّ مِّمَّا جَآءَكُمۡ بِهٖؕ حَتّٰٓى اِذَا هَلَكَ قُلۡتُمۡ لَنۡ يَّبۡعَثَ اللّٰهُ مِنۡۢ بَعۡدِهٖ رَسُوۡلاً  ؕكَذٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ اللّٰهُ مَنۡ هُوَ مُسۡرِفٌ مُّرۡتَابٌۚ ۖ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And, (O people of Egypt,) no doubt Yusuf (Joseph) came to you with clear Signs before this. And you always remained doubtful about those (Signs) which he brought to you until when he passed away, you started saying: Now Allah will never send any Messenger after him. In like manner Allah holds one astray who is a transgressor and a sceptic,

Verses.VerseAr: اۨلَّذِيۡنَ يُجَادِلُوۡنَ فِىۡۤ اٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ بِغَيۡرِ سُلۡطٰنٍ اَتٰٮهُمۡؕ كَبُرَ مَقۡتًا عِنۡدَ اللّٰهِ وَعِنۡدَ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡاؕ كَذٰلِكَ يَطۡبَعُ اللّٰهُ عَلٰى كُلِّ قَلۡبِ مُتَكَبِّرٍ جَبَّارٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Those who argue about the Revelations of Allah without any proof that has come to them, (their argumentation) is awfully displeasing in the sight of Allah and in the sight of believers. That is how Allah seals up the heart of every arrogant (and) tyrant.’

Verses.VerseAr: وَقَالَ فِرۡعَوۡنُ يٰهَامٰنُ ابۡنِ لِىۡ صَرۡحًا لَّعَلِّىۡۤ اَبۡلُغُ الۡاَسۡبَابَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And Pharaoh said: ‘O Haman, build me a towering palace so that (climbing it) I may reach the tracts,

Verses.VerseAr: اَسۡبَابَ السَّمٰوٰتِ فَاَطَّلِعَ اِلٰٓى اِلٰهِ مُوۡسٰى وَاِنِّىۡ لَاَظُنُّهٗ كَاذِبًاؕ وَكَذٰلِكَ زُيِّنَ لِفِرۡعَوۡنَ سُوۡٓءُ عَمَلِهٖ وَصُدَّ عَنِ السَّبِيۡلِؕ وَمَا كَيۡدُ فِرۡعَوۡنَ اِلَّا فِىۡ تَبَابٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: The tracts to the heavens; then I may peep and glance at the God of Musa (Moses); and I consider him but a liar.’ And in this way the evil conduct of Pharaoh was made charming for him and he was hindered from the path (of Allah). And the treacherous plan of Pharaoh was merely a catastrophe.

Verses.VerseAr: وَقَالَ الَّذِىۡۤ اٰمَنَ يٰقَوۡمِ اتَّبِعُوۡنِ اَهۡدِكُمۡ سَبِيۡلَ الرَّشَادِ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And the man who had believed said: ‘O my people, follow me, I will lead you to the path of guidance and piousness.

Verses.VerseAr: يٰقَوۡمِ اِنَّمَا هٰذِهِ الۡحَيٰوةُ الدُّنۡيَا مَتَاعٌ وَّاِنَّ الۡاٰخِرَةَ هِىَ دَارُ الۡقَرَارِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: O my people! The life of this world is nothing but (a few days’) gain and the Hereafter is certainly a home to live in forever.

Verses.VerseAr: مَنۡ عَمِلَ سَيِّئَةً فَلَا يُجۡزٰٓى اِلَّا مِثۡلَهَاۚ وَمَنۡ عَمِلَ صَالِحًـا مِّنۡ ذَكَرٍ اَوۡ اُنۡثٰى وَهُوَ مُؤۡمِنٌ فَاُولٰٓٮِٕكَ يَدۡخُلُوۡنَ الۡجَـنَّةَ يُرۡزَقُوۡنَ فِيۡهَا بِغَيۡرِ حِسَابٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: He who commits evil will not be rewarded but with the same measure. And whoever behaves piously, whether male or female, and is a believer as well, it is they who will enter Paradise. There they will be given sustenance without measure.

Verses.VerseAr: وَيٰقَوۡمِ مَا لِىۡۤ اَدۡعُوۡكُمۡ اِلَى النَّجٰوةِ وَتَدۡعُوۡنَنِىۡۤ اِلَى النَّارِؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And, O my people, what has happened to me that I call you to salvation and you call me to Hell?

Verses.VerseAr: تَدۡعُوۡنَنِىۡ لِاَكۡفُرَ بِاللّٰهِ وَاُشۡرِكَ بِهٖ مَا لَيۡسَ لِىۡ بِهٖ عِلۡمٌ وَّاَنَا اَدۡعُوۡكُمۡ اِلَى الۡعَزِيۡزِ الۡغَفَّارِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: You invite me to deny Allah and associate with Him that of which I have no knowledge, while I invite you to the Almighty God Who is Most Forgiving.

Verses.VerseAr: لَا جَرَمَ اَنَّمَا تَدۡعُوۡنَنِىۡۤ اِلَيۡهِ لَيۡسَ لَهٗ دَعۡوَةٌ فِىۡ الدُّنۡيَا وَلَا فِىۡ الۡاٰخِرَةِ وَاَنَّ مَرَدَّنَاۤ اِلَى اللّٰهِ وَاَنَّ الۡمُسۡرِفِيۡنَ هُمۡ اَصۡحٰبُ النَّارِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: The Truth is that what you are calling me to is not worth calling either in this world or in the Hereafter. And surely our return is to Allah alone, and certainly those who transgress are the inmates of Hell.

Verses.VerseAr: فَسَتَذۡكُرُوۡنَ مَاۤ اَقُوۡلُ لَـكُمۡؕ وَاُفَوِّضُ اَمۡرِىۡۤ اِلَى اللّٰهِؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ بَصِيۡرٌۢ بِالۡعِبَادِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So you will soon recall (these words) that I am saying to you. And I consign my affair to Allah. Surely Allah is Ever-Watchful of the servants.’

Verses.VerseAr: فَوَقٰٮهُ اللّٰهُ سَيِّاٰتِ مَا مَكَرُوۡا وَحَاقَ بِاٰلِ فِرۡعَوۡنَ سُوۡٓءُ الۡعَذَابِ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then Allah safeguarded him against their evils which they were planning. And an evil torment engulfed the people of Pharaoh.

Verses.VerseAr: النَّارُ يُعۡرَضُوۡنَ عَلَيۡهَا غُدُوًّا وَّعَشِيًّاۚ وَّيَوۡمَ تَقُوۡمُ السَّاعَةُ اَدۡخِلُوۡۤا اٰلَ فِرۡعَوۡنَ اَشَدَّ الۡعَذَابِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: They are brought before the Fire of Hell morning and evening. And the Day when Resurrection occurs (a Voice will command:) ‘Cast the people of Pharaoh into the most miserable chastisement.’

Verses.VerseAr: وَاِذۡ يَتَحَآجُّوۡنَ فِىۡ النَّارِ فَيَقُوۡلُ الضُّعَفٰٓؤُا لِلَّذِيۡنَ اسۡتَكۡبَرُوۡۤا اِنَّا كُنَّا لَـكُمۡ تَبَعًا فَهَلۡ اَنۡتُمۡ مُّغۡنُوۡنَ عَنَّا نَصِيۡبًا مِّنَ النَّارِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And when they will fall out with one another in Hell, the weak will say to those who used to show arrogance (in the world): ‘We were your followers, so can you remove from us (even) a portion of the Fire of Hell?’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ الَّذِيۡنَ اسۡتَكۡبَرُوۡۤا اِنَّا كُلٌّ فِيۡهَاۤ  ۙاِنَّ اللّٰهَ قَدۡ حَكَمَ بَيۡنَ الۡعِبَادِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Those who practised arrogance will say: ‘We all are doomed in the same Hell; surely Allah has given His final judgment among the servants.’

Verses.VerseAr: وَقَالَ الَّذِيۡنَ فِىۡ النَّارِ لِخَزَنَةِ جَهَنَّمَ ادۡعُوۡا رَبَّكُمۡ يُخَفِّفۡ عَنَّا يَوۡمًا مِّنَ الۡعَذَابِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And those burning in the Fire will say to the keepers of Hell: ‘Pray to your Lord that He may lessen our torment some day.’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالُوۡۤا اَوَلَمۡ تَكُ تَاۡتِيۡكُمۡ رُسُلُكُمۡ بِالۡبَيِّنٰتِؕ قَالُوۡا بَلٰىؕ قَالُوۡا‌ۚ فَادۡعُوۡا وَمَا دُعٰٓؤُا الۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ اِلَّا فِىۡ ضَلٰلٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: They will say: ‘Did your Messengers not come to you with clear Signs?’ They will reply: ‘Yes, of course.’ (Then the keepers) will say: ‘So pray yourselves.’ But the disbelievers’ prayer will (always) be in vain.

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّا لَنَنۡصُرُ رُسُلَنَا وَالَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا فِىۡ الۡحَيٰوةِ الدُّنۡيَا وَيَوۡمَ يَقُوۡمُ الۡاَشۡهَادُۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Surely We help Our Messengers and those who believe, in the life of this world and (will also help) on the Day when the witnesses will rise,

Verses.VerseAr: يَوۡمَ لَا يَنۡفَعُ الظّٰلِمِيۡنَ مَعۡذِرَتُهُمۡ وَلَهُمُ اللَّعۡنَةُ وَلَهُمۡ سُوۡٓءُ الدَّارِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: The Day when the excuse of the wrongdoers will not benefit them. And there will be curse on them, and for them will be the evil home (in Hell).

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَقَدۡ اٰتَيۡنَا مُوۡسَى الۡهُدٰى وَاَوۡرَثۡنَا بَنِىۡۤ اِسۡرَآءِيۡلَ الۡكِتٰبَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And verily We gave Musa ([Moses] the Book) of guidance and (after him) We made the Children of Israel the inheritors of that (Book),

Verses.VerseAr: هُدًى وَّذِكۡرٰى لِاُولِىۡ الۡاَلۡبَابِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Guidance and a Reminder for those who possess wisdom.

Verses.VerseAr: فَاصۡبِرۡ اِنَّ وَعۡدَ اللّٰهِ حَقٌّ وَّاسۡتَغۡفِرۡ لِذَنۡۢبِكَ وَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّكَ بِالۡعَشِىِّ وَالۡاِبۡكَارِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So keep patience. Assuredly the Promise of Allah is true. And ask forgiveness for the sins of your Umma (Community) and glorify your Lord with His praise in the evening and in the morning

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ يُجَادِلُوۡنَ فِىۡۤ اٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ بِغَيۡرِ سُلۡطٰنٍ اَتٰٮهُمۡۙ اِنۡ فِىۡ صُدُوۡرِهِمۡ اِلَّا كِبۡرٌ مَّا هُمۡ بِبَالِغِيۡهِؕ فَاسۡتَعِذۡ بِاللّٰهِؕ اِنَّهٗ هُوَ السَّمِيۡعُ الۡبَصِيۡرُ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Surely those who argue about the Revelations of Allah without any authority having come to them, there is nothing in their breasts except vain superiority; they will never be able to attain to that (true superiority). So keep seeking refuge with Allah (from their evil). Surely He alone is All-Hearing, All-Seeing.

Verses.VerseAr: لَخَلۡقُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ اَكۡبَرُ مِنۡ خَلۡقِ النَّاسِ وَلٰكِنَّ اَكۡثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Surely the creation of the heavens and the earth is far greater than the creation of mankind but most people do not know.

Verses.VerseAr: وَمَا يَسۡتَوِىۡ الۡاَعۡمٰى وَالۡبَصِيۡرُ  ۙ وَالَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوۡا الصّٰلِحٰتِ وَلَا الۡمُسِىۡٓءُؕ قَلِيۡلاً مَّا تَتَذَكَّرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And the blind and the seeing cannot be equal. So (in the same way) those who believe and do righteous works and the evildoers too cannot be (alike). You accept direction and guidance but little.

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّ السَّاعَةَ لَاٰتِيَةٌ لَّا رَيۡبَ فِيۡهَا وَلٰكِنَّ اَكۡثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Surely the Last Hour is bound to come. There is no doubt in that. Yet most people do not believe.

Verses.VerseAr: وَقَالَ رَبُّكُمُ ادۡعُوۡنِىۡۤ اَسۡتَجِبۡ لَكُمۡؕ اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ يَسۡتَكۡبِرُوۡنَ عَنۡ عِبَادَتِىۡ سَيَدۡخُلُوۡنَ جَهَنَّمَ دَاخِرِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And your Lord has said: ‘Always pray to Me; I shall certainly grant your prayer. Surely those who turn away from My worship in defiance will soon enter Hell disgraced.’

Verses.VerseAr: اللّٰهُ الَّذِىۡ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الَّيۡلَ لِتَسۡكُنُوۡا فِيۡهِ وَالنَّهَارَ مُبۡصِرًاؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَذُوۡ فَضۡلٍ عَلَى النَّاسِ وَلٰكِنَّ اَكۡثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَشۡكُرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Allah is the One Who has made the night for you to repose in and brightened the day to see; surely Allah is Bountiful to mankind but most people do not give thanks.

Verses.VerseAr: ذٰلِكُمُ اللّٰهُ رَبُّكُمۡ خَالِقُ كُلِّ شَىۡءٍ‌ۘ لَّاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ‌ۚ فَاَنّٰى تُؤۡفَكُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: That is Allah, your Lord, Who is the Creator of everything. There is no God apart from Him. So where are you wandering disorientated?

Verses.VerseAr: كَذٰلِكَ يُؤۡفَكُ الَّذِيۡنَ كَانُوۡا بِاٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ يَجۡحَدُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Likewise were wandering distracted those who used to deny the Revelations of Allah.

Verses.VerseAr: اللّٰهُ الَّذِىۡ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الۡاَرۡضَ قَرَارًا وَّالسَّمَآءَ بِنَآءً وَّصَوَّرَكُمۡ فَاَحۡسَنَ صُوَرَكُمۡ وَرَزَقَكُمۡ مِّنَ الطَّيِّبٰتِؕ ذٰلِكُمُ اللّٰهُ رَبُّكُمۡ‌ ۖۚ فَتَبٰرَكَ اللّٰهُ رَبُّ الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Allah is the One Who made the earth a dwelling place for you and the heaven a ceiling and gave you form and features and then perfected your shapes and granted you sustenance of pure things. Such is Allah, your Lord. So Blessed is Allah, the Lord of all the worlds.

Verses.VerseAr: هُوَ الۡحَىُّ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ فَادۡعُوۡهُ مُخۡلِصِيۡنَ لَهُ الدِّيۡنَؕ الۡحَمۡدُ لِلّٰهِ رَبِّ الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: He is the Ever-Living. There is no God but He. So worship Him making obedience and devotion sincerely His. All praise belongs to Allah alone, the Lord of all the worlds.

Verses.VerseAr: قُلۡ اِنِّىۡ نُهِيۡتُ اَنۡ اَعۡبُدَ الَّذِيۡنَ تَدۡعُوۡنَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ لَمَّا جَآءَنِىَ الۡبَيِّنٰتُ مِنۡ رَّبِّىۡ وَاُمِرۡتُ اَنۡ اُسۡلِمَ لِرَبِّ الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Say: ‘I have been forbidden to worship those idols that you worship apart from Allah whereas manifest Signs have come to me from my Lord and I have been commanded to obey the Lord of all the worlds.’

Verses.VerseAr: هُوَ الَّذِىۡ خَلَقَكُمۡ مِّنۡ تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ مِنۡ نُّطۡفَةٍ ثُمَّ مِنۡ عَلَقَةٍ ثُمَّ يُخۡرِجُكُمۡ طِفۡلاً ثُمَّ لِتَبۡلُغُوۡۤا اَشُدَّكُمۡ ثُمَّ لِتَكُوۡنُوۡا شُيُوۡخًاؕ وَمِنۡكُمۡ مَّنۡ يُّتَوَفّٰى مِنۡ قَبۡلُ وَلِتَبۡلُغُوۡۤا اَجَلاً مُّسَمًّى وَلَعَلَّكُمۡ تَعۡقِلُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: He is the One Who initiated (the genesis of) your (chemical life) from clay, then (your biological genesis) from a sperm drop (zygote), then from a hanging mass (in the mother’s womb). Then (eventually) He is the One Who brings you forth as an infant then (nourishes you), so that you may reach your maturity. (Then He grants you a period of life,) so that you may grow old. And some of you die early (before senility). And (the purpose of all this is) that you may complete your respective appointed terms and (also) that you may comprehend.

Verses.VerseAr: هُوَ الَّذِىۡ يُحۡىٖ وَيُمِيۡتُؕ فَاِذَا قَضٰٓى اَمۡرًا فَاِنَّمَا يَقُوۡلُ لَهٗ كُنۡ فَيَكُوۡنُ‏
Verses.VerseEn: He is the One Who gives life and causes death. Then when He decides upon a thing He says to it only: ‘Be,’ so it becomes.

Verses.VerseAr: اَلَمۡ تَرَ اِلَى الَّذِيۡنَ يُجَادِلُوۡنَ فِىۡۤ اٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِؕ اَنّٰى يُصۡرَفُوۡنَۛ ۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Have you not seen those who argue about the Revelations of Allah? Where are they straying?

Verses.VerseAr: الَّذِيۡنَ كَذَّبُوۡا بِالۡكِتٰبِ وَبِمَاۤ اَرۡسَلۡنَا بِهٖ رُسُلَنَاۛ فَسَوۡفَ يَعۡلَمُوۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Those who have rejected the Book (as well as) the Signs with which We sent Our Messengers, they will know (their end) soon,

Verses.VerseAr: اِذِ الۡاَغۡلٰلُ فِىۡۤ اَعۡنَاقِهِمۡ وَالسَّلٰسِلُؕ يُسۡحَبُوۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: When they have iron collars round their necks and chains, and they will be dragged away,

Verses.VerseAr: فِىۡ الۡحَمِيۡمِ ۙ  ثُمَّ فِىۡ النَّارِ يُسۡجَرُوۡنَ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Into the boiling water and then will be thrown into the Fire as fuel.

Verses.VerseAr: ثُمَّ قِيۡلَ لَهُمۡ اَيۡنَ مَا كُنۡتُمۡ تُشۡرِكُوۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then it will be said to them: ‘Where are those (idols) which you used to set up as partners,

Verses.VerseAr: مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِؕ قَالُوۡا ضَلُّوۡا عَنَّا بَل لَّمۡ نَكُنۡ نَّدۡعُوۡا مِنۡ قَبۡلُ شَيْئًا ؕ كَذٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ اللّٰهُ الۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Apart from Allah?’ They will say: ‘They have been lost from us. In fact we never worshipped anything before.’ That is how Allah holds the disbelievers astray.

Verses.VerseAr: ذٰلِكُمۡ بِمَا كُنۡتُمۡ تَفۡرَحُوۡنَ فِىۡ الۡاَرۡضِ بِغَيۡرِ الۡحَقِّ وَبِمَا كُنۡتُمۡ تَمۡرَحُوۡنَ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: This (punishment) is the requital of your undue rejoicing in the earth and the recompense of your gloating.

Verses.VerseAr: اُدۡخُلُوۡۤا اَبۡوَابَ جَهَنَّمَ خٰلِدِيۡنَ فِيۡهَاۚ فَبِئۡسَ مَثۡوَى الۡمُتَكَبِّرِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Enter the gates of Hell. You will live in it forever. So how evil is the abode of the arrogant!

Verses.VerseAr: فَاصۡبِرۡ اِنَّ وَعۡدَ اللّٰهِ حَقٌّ  ۚ فَاِمَّا نُرِيَنَّكَ بَعۡضَ الَّذِىۡ نَعِدُهُمۡ اَوۡ نَتَوَفَّيَنَّكَ فَاِلَيۡنَا يُرۡجَعُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So keep patience. Surely Allah’s promise is true. Then whether We show you a portion of that (torment) which We have promised them or make you depart from visible life before that, (in both cases) they will be returned to Us.

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَقَدۡ اَرۡسَلۡنَا رُسُلاً مِّنۡ قَبۡلِكَ مِنۡهُمۡ مَّنۡ قَصَصۡنَا عَلَيۡكَ وَمِنۡهُمۡ مَّنۡ لَّمۡ نَقۡصُصۡ عَلَيۡكَؕ وَمَا كَانَ لِرَسُوۡلٍ اَنۡ يَّاۡتِىَ بِاٰيَةٍ اِلَّا بِاِذۡنِ اللّٰه‌ِۚ فَاِذَا جَآءَ اَمۡرُ اللّٰهِ قُضِىَ بِالۡحَقِّ وَخَسِرَ هُنَالِكَ الۡمُبۡطِلُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And no doubt We sent many Messengers before you. We have given you an account of some of them while We have not (yet) narrated to you the annals of some others. And it was not possible for any Messenger to bring any Sign without Allah’s leave. Then when the command of Allah came (and) the judgment was given with truth and justice the exponents of evil went into loss.

Verses.VerseAr: اَللّٰهُ الَّذِىۡ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الۡاَنۡعَامَ لِتَرۡكَبُوۡا مِنۡهَا وَمِنۡهَا تَاۡكُلُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Allah is the One Who has created cattle for you so that you may ride some of them and some of them you eat.

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَكُمۡ فِيۡهَا مَنَافِعُ وَلِتَبۡلُغُوۡا عَلَيۡهَا حَاجَةً فِىۡ صُدُوۡرِكُمۡ وَعَلَيۡهَا وَعَلَى الۡفُلۡكِ تُحۡمَلُوۡنَؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And in them are for you other benefits too. So you may ride them (further) to reach that desired (place) which is (determined) in your hearts, and (that) you are borne on them and the boats.

Verses.VerseAr: وَيُرِيۡكُمۡ اٰيٰتِهٖۖ فَاَىَّ اٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ تُنۡكِرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And He shows you (many of) His Signs. So which of Allah’s Signs will you deny?

Verses.VerseAr: اَفَلَمۡ يَسِيۡرُوۡا فِىۡ الۡاَرۡضِ فَيَنۡظُرُوۡا كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الَّذِيۡنَ مِنۡ قَبۡلِهِمۡؕ كَانُوۡۤا اَكۡثَرَ مِنۡهُمۡ وَاَشَدَّ قُوَّةً وَّاٰثَارًا فِىۡ الۡاَرۡضِ فَمَاۤ اَغۡنٰى عَنۡهُمۡ مَّا كَانُوۡا يَكۡسِبُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So have they not travelled in the earth that they could see how they met their fate who passed before them? They were far greater (in number) than these people and mightier in power and (much more advanced) in respect of the remains and traces (as well) that (they) have left behind in the earth. But whatever they used to earn brought them no benefit.

Verses.VerseAr: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتۡهُمۡ رُسُلُهُمۡ بِالۡبَيِّنٰتِ فَرِحُوۡا بِمَا عِنۡدَهُمۡ مِّنَ الۡعِلۡمِ وَحَاقَ بِهِمۡ مَّا كَانُوۡا بِهٖ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So when their Messengers came to them with manifest Signs, they kept rejoicing in the pride of (the worldly) knowledge and skill they possessed. And (in the same state) that torment engulfed them which they used to mock.

Verses.VerseAr: فَلَمَّا رَاَوۡا بَاۡسَنَا قَالُوۡۤا اٰمَنَّا بِاللّٰهِ وَحۡدَهٗ وَكَفَرۡنَا بِمَا كُنَّا بِهٖ مُشۡرِكِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: But when they saw Our torment they started saying: ‘We believe in Allah, the One, and reject (all) those we used to associate with Him as partners.’

Verses.VerseAr: فَلَمۡ يَكُ يَنۡفَعُهُمۡ اِيۡمَانُهُمۡ لَمَّا رَاَوۡا بَاۡسَنَا  ؕ سُنَّتَ اللّٰهِ الَّتِىۡ قَدۡ خَلَتۡ فِىۡ عِبَادِه‌ۚ وَخَسِرَ هُنَالِكَ الۡكٰفِرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then their acceptance of faith could not profit them at all while they had seen Our torment. That is Allah’s pattern which has ever been in practice in respect of His servants and the disbelievers always suffered heavy loss at this juncture.
